reply.summary: Anlas is a wiry cat burglar from a harbour town who folds the air around him and steps out a street away. He robs vaults for a cause he calls pride, though his crew mostly wants the payout.

feats.scene: Anlas yanks a loaded delivery van through a fold in the air and drops it onto a rooftop.
Anlas shrugs off a thrown bar stool and a cracked rib without slowing his escape.

reply.summary: Iuveoca is a wanderer with no fixed address who opens doorways in empty air and can push crates, cars or captives through them. A cruel experiment left a hole in the wanderer's memory that still leaks into every plan.

feats.scene: Iuveoca opens twin gateways above a bridge and drops a freight container through them onto a pursuing convoy.
Iuveoca takes a rifle volley at close range and stumbles up bruised and furious.

reply.summary: Liatele is a hulking gangster whose hands grew so oversized in childhood that the neighbourhood nicknamed him after a mallet. He runs a protection racket and insists he is only a shopkeeper with a sideline.

feats.scene: Liatele flattens a steel shutter with a single downward blow of his fists.
Liatele takes a bat across the shoulders and keeps counting his takings.

reply.summary: Orsereo is a masked vengeance-seeker from a far-future federation of youth squads, driven by a grudge nobody else remembers. Orsereo hunts rivals across the stars with stolen weapons and patient cruelty.

feats.scene: Orsereo fires a stolen cannon and melts a docking clamp the size of a barn door.
Orsereo walks out of a collapsing hangar with only a scorched cloak.

reply.summary: Liunelle is a dry-witted field handler who runs ugly missions from a basement control room and never raises her voice. Her father drilled her to be a soldier, and she treats loyalty as something to be audited.

feats.scene: Liunelle swings a rifle butt and drops a guard who tried to leave his post.
Liunelle rides out a stairwell fall and walks back to her desk muttering about paperwork.

reply.summary: Ianrn is a former clerk from a quiet city who learned she belonged to a buried race with pale skin and a hunger for blood. She moves objects with her mind and smiles for cameras between rescues.

feats.scene: Ianrn lifts a parked truck with her mind and hurls it against a tunnel wall.
Ianrn shakes off a collapsing cavern ceiling and brushes dust from her sleeves.

reply.summary: Telau is a bright schoolgirl who drowned trying to save a friend, then lived on in old film reels and a grieving father's laboratory. Telau has no powers of her own, only a legacy of love and a copied face.

feats.scene: Telau splashes frantically and tugs a friend toward the pier with all the strength a child has.
Telau holds her breath under cold water far longer than a child should.

reply.summary: Rnili is a wartime spy who stepped into a haunted laboratory and stayed trapped in a timeless pocket for generations. Rnili still moves with the discipline of a commando and has aged not a day.

feats.scene: Rnili vaults a railing and drives a boot heel through a brittle wooden door.
Rnili survives years in a place without food, light or sleep and still stands her ground.

reply.summary: Rantanu is a harried aide and parent who was dosed with a glowing mineral and made to carry a second mind that takes the wheel on command. Rantanu fights the hijacker daily to keep a family together.

feats.scene: Rantanu punches through a barn wall and sends a farm truck tumbling across the yard.
Rantanu brushes off a canister of caustic gas and a flurry of blows.

reply.summary: Llenuter is a composed academic administrator who once helped a beloved teacher chase a hole in time and lost him for decades. Llenuter now runs a faculty office with calm authority and a private soft spot.

feats.scene: Llenuter slams a ledger onto the desk and silences a rowdy committee.
Llenuter endures decades of regret and a bruising divorce without losing her poise.

reply.summary: Statiusor is a violet-eyed shapeshifter whose body rearranges into whatever substance the moment demands, from brick to vapour. A fractured mind makes allies nervous, yet the help is genuine.

feats.scene: Statiusor hardens an arm into granite and caves in the roof of an armoured transport.
Statiusor turns to vapour as a shell strikes and re-forms in the next doorway.

reply.summary: Iumcoran was a loft painter who sketched a nightmare without meaning to, and the nightmare stepped off the canvas. A sorrowful tale among occultists, and her art still hangs in a few dusty galleries.

feats.scene: Iumcoran flings a jar of turpentine and a palette knife at the thing crawling from her easel.
Iumcoran clings to a windowsill for a few seconds before the horror shoves her loose.

reply.summary: Liunumeor is a grandiose schemer who builds a humming device that drains ambition from a whole nation, then crowns himself ruler by popular apathy. His scheme works on everyone but a certain caped visitor.

feats.scene: Liunumeor switches on a rooftop emitter and floods a metropolis with a dulling radiance.
Liunumeor tumbles down a marble stair in his ceremonial robes and bounces up unhurt.

reply.summary: Sematir is an aloof sovereign over a ring of frozen moons who sends spies down to a warring world before planning conquest. Sematir reads minds across a throne room and trades treaties like cattle.

feats.scene: Sematir orders a battery of ice cannons to fire and levels a mining dome.
Sematir sits through a shattering mutiny with the throne cracking beneath him.

reply.summary: Stistesi is a cruel monarch of a lost island city dressed like an ancient capital, where bloodshed is a festival. Stistesi lives for applause and orders captives into the arena.

feats.scene: Stistesi signals the gladiators to charge and the crowd roars at her command.
Stistesi absorbs a thrown goblet and a rebel's slap without losing her smile.

reply.summary: Ornist is a vast limb of primordial darkness that woke up and learned to command nightmares from the fifth dimension. Ornist erases whole story-worlds to feed a machine built for finality.

feats.scene: Ornist closes its fist and a bundle of parallel worlds goes dark at once.
Ornist is struck by a coalition of champions and the blow dissolves into nothing.

reply.summary: Talneo is a blue-skinned warrior from a scorched dominion of tyrants whose lightest touch can freeze a victim's muscles or stop a heart. Talneo serves a vicious cult as a living poison dart.

feats.scene: Talneo lays a palm on an armoured guard and the man drops rigid like a felled tree.
Talneo walks through a collapsing furnace hall and out the other side.

reply.summary: Tauanceo is an ancient sorceress who dresses as a street musician or a sweet old landlady and sheds the disguise at a single spoken word. Tauanceo stashes a shard of fate in a drawer and trades gossip with gods.

feats.scene: Tauanceo whispers a word and her cottage swells into a stone hall with sealed gates.
Tauanceo sits calmly as a ceiling beam crashes through her and she re-forms as a cat.

reply.summary: Seoror is a grey-skinned being who says it was present before the beginning and will remain after the end. Seoror trades fearlessness for tears and later comes to collect, waking statues to do the work.

feats.scene: Seoror whispers over a graveyard and a hundred stone angels climb down to hunt.
Seoror stands unmoved as a rain of bullets turns to harmless dust in her palm.

reply.summary: Vorco is a sealed-away deity of an older age who borrows a mortal host to walk again, bringing a brother and a plan to bury cities in darkness. Vorco is worshipped in an unmapped cave and hated in every other place.

feats.scene: Vorco raises a swirling ring of dark light above a city centre and its towers crumble.
Vorco walks through a barrage of heavy shells with a bored expression.

reply.summary: Anran is a spiteful spirit that rides in an innocent painter and floats over the roofs shouting at passers-by. Anran can do nothing alone and stays tangled in an argument for control of a single body.

feats.scene: Anran flings a column of green fire at a parked car and sends it spinning down the avenue.
Anran is shaken by a thrown talisman and nearly slips out of the borrowed body.

reply.summary: Liallole is a witch who lodged inside a designer and fed on her for years, whispering of a conquest that spans dozens of worlds. Liallole throws bolts, bends minds and conjures minions when bored.

feats.scene: Liallole hurls a lance of violet energy and levels a row of warehouses.
Liallole wraps herself in a glimmering dome and a tank shell splashes across it.

reply.summary: Amotiu is the idea of finality wearing the shape of a quiet boy, born to a mother who thought he was a messiah of fear. Amotiu can become a cosmic projectile that unmakes stories, and a gunner sent him through a rift.

feats.scene: Amotiu is fired through a crack in reality and every shelf of the great archive begins to blank.
Amotiu is hurled into the heart of a dying cosmos and comes out untouched.

reply.summary: Titeson is a smalltime counterfeiter who carves printing plates by candlelight and sells forged notes to anyone with a bag of cash. Titeson fights with a chisel and a lot of nerve against a masked hero in a bulletproof helmet.

feats.scene: Titeson swipes a chisel at a pursuer and gouges the door frame.
Titeson takes a fall from a warehouse loft and limps for the alley.

reply.summary: Niirn is a puzzle-obsessed crook who leaves cryptic notes at each heist and wears a question-mark mask. Niirn picks locks, forges alibis and runs from a scarab-armoured pursuer.

feats.scene: Niirn swings a crowbar and shatters a jewellery case.
Niirn is thrown into a stack of crates and scrambles up again.

reply.summary: Siulloll is a red-haired schoolkid in a cartoon version of a heroic team who tells groan-worthy jokes with a staff in hand. Siulloll proves the punchline can floor a stronger classmate.

feats.scene: Siulloll taps a playground bully with her staff and he collapses in giggles.
Siulloll tumbles off the monkey bars and bounces up laughing.

reply.summary: Iumiu is a yellow-skinned jailer who feeds on the terror of captives and presides over torture cells on a living planet. Iumiu swings a glowing cutlass until a young soldier splits him in two, and he later rises again as a hollow husk.

feats.scene: Iumiu sends a wave of dread-powered light through a prison block and shatters its walls.
Iumiu takes a cutting blast across the ribs and stays on his feet for a moment.

reply.summary: Sovor is the stern warden of a shadowy afterlife where fallen gods go to rest. Sovor tests visitors with rock-splitting blows and is outwitted when a trickster simply refuses to fight back.

feats.scene: Sovor swings a fist and cracks a stone pillar the width of a tower.
Sovor is buried beneath a toppled column and digs himself out, cursing.

reply.summary: Ralvalu is a gentle conservationist who can reshape living tissue, turning beasts into people and back again. Ralvalu is stuck in a lion-like body and spends his days protecting dwindling species.

feats.scene: Ralvalu lunges and claws a steel gate off its hinges.
Ralvalu stumbles out of a crashed transport shuttle with a few scratches.

reply.summary: Teranli is a haunted man who bargained with a smiling merchant to save his town and became a hulking creature of water and rubbish. Teranli has lost the curse but keeps a knack for stealing strength from nearby bargainers.

feats.scene: Teranli smashes a gas pump apart with a swollen fist and a blast of foul water.
Teranli, in his junkyard shape, shrugs off a shotgun at point blank range.

reply.summary: Torrn is an elderly mafia patriarch who runs racketeering rings from a dim restaurant and speaks quietly about respect. Torrn bribes officials, crushes rivals through lawyers and trusts family before everyone else.

feats.scene: Torrn raps his cane on the table and three bodyguards leap to work.
Torrn sits through a hostile interrogation without a flicker of worry.

reply.summary: Ausial is a vast cosmic force that settles into a dying alien pilot and tries to guide the world toward peace. Ausial gives its host flickering power while pulling the strings from a place beyond sight.

feats.scene: Ausial pours light through its host and burns a canyon through a mountain range.
Ausial endures a stellar flare with its host body glowing but whole.

reply.summary: Sersesrnu is a green-eyed demon in a family of squabbling brothers who gather in the underworld for gatherings and picnics. Sersesrnu is jealous of everything and is easily tricked into brawling with his own siblings.

feats.scene: Sersesrnu hurls a flaming boulder across the cavern and splits a pillar of obsidian.
Sersesrnu falls from a ledge of basalt and shakes it off with a snort.

reply.summary: Aunanurn is a scientist-turned-criminal who taps a hidden current of velocity and runs in a sulphur-yellow costume. Aunanurn is accused of being a hero in disguise by his own crew of thieves.

feats.scene: Aunanurn sprints into a vault door and tears it from its mount.
Aunanurn is knocked cold and unmasked by a lucky swing of a bottle.
Aunanurn blurs across a casino floor and is gone before the dice stop rolling.

reply.summary: Nenco is a mad inventor from the far future who rides a surge of speed and reaches back to plague a family of runners. Nenco allies with a space-ring villain to swap places with rivals and send them to prison.

feats.scene: Nenco charges a vibrating blow and drills a hole through a reinforced bank wall.
Nenco is flung through a billboard and rolls to his feet in a flash.
Nenco outpaces a jet fighter across the desert and laughs at the dust.

reply.summary: Nallu is a shambling gestalt of thousands of living brains, stitched into one body to serve a distant tyrant. Nallu hurls psychic and physical blasts, reshapes his limbs and flies, and dies only if every brain does.

feats.scene: Nallu focuses a psychic storm that tears the facade off a skyscraper.
Nallu rebuilds his body mid-fall and takes a missile on the chest.

reply.summary: Vaarcol is a centuries-old blade assassin infused with a mineral alloy that mends flesh again and again, powered by body heat. Vaarcol lost his post for sloppiness and is hungry to win back standing.

feats.scene: Vaarcol hurls five knives in a fan and pins a fleeing target to the wall.
Vaarcol is hurled from a skyscraper ledge and rises, bones knitting back.

reply.summary: Rautir is a calm island physician in a nation of warrior women, trained with bow, blade and horse yet happiest with poultices. Rautir mends comrades after battles and carries the blessing of two goddesses.

feats.scene: Rautir draws a bow and sends an arrow through a practice shield.
Rautir takes a sword cut across her arm and finishes bandaging a patient.

reply.summary: Enunus is a lab-grown agent blended from several heroic donors who works for a hidden agency and jokes with her two sisters. Enunus is strong, quick and tough enough to topple a hero with a distraction.

feats.scene: Enunus slams a car door through a windshield and grabs the shopping cart with a baby clone inside.
Enunus tumbles off a rooftop and sprints toward the getaway car.

reply.summary: Iasve is a blue-haired alchemist who was sent to a school of brews as a girl and can mix a potion for love, sleep or revival. Iasve is a loyal helper to a scruffy occultist and bears the cost of every botched resurrection.

feats.scene: Iasve shatters a vial of volatile salts and blows the door off a crypt.
Iasve sinks into an enchanted coma and breathes slowly for weeks.

reply.summary: Torsiuora is a greedy chrono-thief who learned to bend minutes and centuries, plundering every age he can reach. Torsiuora lugs stolen weapons from the far future and rules a palace outside the stream of days.

feats.scene: Torsiuora freezes a battlefield between two ticks and smashes a fortress with arrows plucked from tomorrow.
Torsiuora is caught under a collapsing roof and steps sideways into an earlier hour.

reply.summary: Riaole is a blond temporal engineer who haunts a ship graveyard and constructs a machine meant to rewrite history. Riaole remembers futures that never happened and wears a suit that shields him from paradox.

feats.scene: Riaole powers up a mechanism and a wing of the wreckage rewinds into whole condition.
Riaole is blasted by a salvage crew and the suit disperses the hit.

reply.summary: Stnenria is a sullen orphan with a ghostly talent that flows through a host child and pretends to be a friendly vigilante. Stnenria shows his true colours after earning a team's trust and then turns on them.

feats.scene: Stnenria hurls a burst of raw force that dents a patrol car and sends cops sprawling.
Stnenria is hit by a tranquilliser volley and keeps going on adrenaline.

reply.summary: Teialvar is a six-armed alien horror that spreads a plague which makes every victim identical to the people around them. Teialvar is the reason an entire neighbourhood becomes bland and predictable.

feats.scene: Teialvar sweeps a spray of spores across a city district and flattens everyone's skill to the same level.
Teialvar absorbs a barrage of rockets with six folded arms.

reply.summary: Velasor is a blond mage born from light and shadow, aged into manhood almost at once. Velasor draws power from both lamp and gloom, though he never inherited his mother's famous strength.

feats.scene: Velasor gathers dusk and dawn in his hands and detonates a spire of crystal.
Velasor stands within a ward of shimmering force as the cavern caves in.

reply.summary: Colsorlu is a masked mediator raised by rival cosmic forces to keep them level, who burned out and began enforcing balance with traps and giant scales. Colsorlu dangles captives over fire to prove his point.

feats.scene: Colsorlu tips a colossal scale and a platform of molten stone drops into the dark.
Colsorlu is struck by a flurry of gadgets and answers with a shrug.

reply.summary: Rireo is a mammoth cyborg mercenary clad in synthetic skin over a metal frame, grown in a hidden bunker and unleashed to test travellers. Rireo has red eyes, bone talons and limbs that regrow.

feats.scene: Rireo tears a rail wagon in half with bare claws.
Rireo is hit by a flying kick and a chop that severs an arm, then regrows it.

reply.summary: Valntiton is a mechanical enforcer built to police a conquered world for a ruling dynasty and the face of its harsh purity. Valntiton is strong, fast and airborne, and fires energy bolts at prisoners.

feats.scene: Valntiton fires a lance of white energy and rips open a prison gate.
Valntiton walks through a collapsing bunker with only a smoking shoulder plate.
Valntiton streaks over a plain in pursuit of escapees.

reply.summary: Annese is a spectral guardian that gathers a fallen hero's body into a glowing matrix and fails to revive him. Annese asks his widow to share a body and carry on the fight, and the two merge hand to hand.

feats.scene: Annese channels glowing energy through a joined hand and lifts a collapsed overpass.
Annese endures the heat of the burning matrix without flinching.

reply.summary: Eocorleo is a living copy built from a dead hero's blueprint, keeping a quiet watch in an arctic hall of crystal. Eocorleo took the vanished champion's place in a bleak alternate timeline where everyone forgot the original.

feats.scene: Eocorleo punches a rogue asteroid fragment out of the sky and it shatters over empty sea.
Eocorleo is hit by a runaway train and keeps walking toward the horizon.
Eocorleo races a missile along the coast and arrives first.
